Use case: stylized-concept. NEW KFB weird surreal worker-family illustration. Exactly SIX complete UNIQUE ink blob cartoon claymation monsters, landscape1536x1024 transparent PNG sheet3columns by2rows. STYLE reference1: original veteran ONLY rounded ink body and plasticine material. STYLE reference2: original RPG sheet ONLY rich hand-sculpted accessory craft, not repeated faces, red eyeballs or source identities. Start six new characters, not edits of previous generated sheets. Thick continuous charcoal-black ink bodies with subtle dark violet sheen, rounded asymmetric splat lobes and a few round ink droplets, short goo hands. Huge expressive faces directly in body. Whole upright FOOTLESS blobs, no human torso, no legs, feet or cropped busts. Rich soft modeled plasticine with fine fingerprints and thick handmade fabric, leather, wood, metal; never angular stone, coarse patchy camouflage or glossy generic Pixar human. Exactly TWO female-read subtly via lashes/headwrap/lids, no human anatomy. WHITE/IVORY EYEBALLS, RED IRIS, BLACK PUPIL. Eyes exposed, goggles only above eyes; clay eyelids fully violet, not ivory. Lip color normally same purple-black as body, not random rosy human lips. Teeth originate INSIDE mouth only; upper teeth descend from roof/gum above lower lip, no teeth on exterior lips, closed mouths toothless. Vary mouth/acting genuinely. Props few bold and FUNCTIONAL: simple correct handle/tool connections, clear wrists/grips, not complicated nonsense machinery. Emotions absurd and relatable, maximum readable acting at decisive moment. Costume is small patches/panels around body, never a full humanoid outfit. No signage text or generic gag labels.
FAMILY: 1920er – Ausschuss für die letzte Geduld. COSTUME: fictional1920s striking industrial workers, worn flatcaps, headscarves, tiny rolled-sleeve tabs, patched canvas, muted brick red/navy/cream, handmade union props without legible text; compassionate labour satire, not a riot or battle scene.
TOP LEFT — Vertrauensfrau Lautgenug, weiblich-read. round broad upright splat in dark red tied headscarf, subtle lashes, small old-fashioned speaking trumpet low beside cheek and a rolled petition; one eye wide other focused, giant open asymmetric rallying mouth with TWO upper teeth. Personality: Can turn a roomful of separate worries into one audible sentence.
TOP MIDDLE — Streikposten Nochimmer, maennlich-read. tall thin curved blob, battered brown flatcap and tiny neckerchief, short wooden picket paddle with EMPTY weathered cream board and no text; heavy lopsided lids, closed crooked toothless stubborn lips. Personality: Has perfected the difficult art of standing his ground without feet.
TOP RIGHT — Flugblattwart Vervielfacht, maennlich-read. squat top-heavy blob, soft indigo cap and simple cloth sleeve tabs, stack of small cream leaflets with only abstract printing marks, one loose leaflet in goo hand; bulging unequal eyes, little triangular open mouth without teeth. Personality: Has enough copies for everyone except the person who asked.
BOTTOM LEFT — Delegierter Nochnefrage, maennlich-read. tall broad-based pear splat, dark flatcap slightly tilted and little waistcoat panels, small pocket watch on short chain and folded demand list without legible words; sideways triumphant grin with THREE internal upper teeth, one cheek raised. Personality: Arrives at negotiations with the time and none of the patience.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — Kassenwartin Kleingeld, weiblich-read. low wide square rounded blob, tied blue-grey headscarf and two lashes, small wooden collection box with visible coin slot and THREE large coins; skeptical one-brow lift, huge toothless downturned mouth. Personality: Makes solidarity last until Friday and occasionally beyond.
BOTTOM RIGHT — Suppenwart Weiterwarm, maennlich-read. round lopsided splat, old soft cream cap with patched brim, small lidded metal soup pot at flank and stout ladle; gently worried high brows, uneven closed toothless smile. Personality: Keeps the soup warm while everybody argues about the future.
COMPOSITION: Equal substantial full-body visual scale, three columns/two rows, each complete character within its own roughly460x440pixel area. Similar figure heights across rows, no shrinking bottom row. At least32px clear transparent inter-row/column gutters and generous outer margin. Separate silhouettes/props/droplets, no overlaps or cropped objects. Camera-facing character posing with slight twist. No background color, scenery, factory/building/fire/waterground, ground plane, shadow discs, labels, letters, numbers, watermark, borders or gridlines. Genuine transparent alpha.
